description: She wears an opaque cream-and-gold patterned floor-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice, narrow decorated shoulder straps and elbow-length sleeves resting below the shoulders. Gold geometric embroidery and dark gold borders frame the bodice, waist, front skirt opening and hem. Round gold ornaments sit at the neckline sides and several linked ornamental pendants hang from the ornate belt. A broad ochre-gold wrap with dark geometric patterned borders falls loosely around her arms and down the sides. Large gold drop earrings, a necklace with small hanging pendants, bracelets and rings accompany the outfit. A gold-brown closed-toe patterned shoe is visible below the modest lower opening. No headgear or weapons appear.
